svg.title: The datasets in construction-data
svg.desc: Reference data as plain CSV: Starter cost codes 142, Glossary terms 87, Unit conversions 47, Pay units 46, CSI divisions 34, Trade sequence steps 30, Waste factors 24, Metric formulas 24, Earthwork factors 7.
